scope: L1-14/R01-R07 independent pinned Supabase reference contracts, NOT native/SDK auth parity or signoff

tests.name: L1-14/R01 reference NEW signup detected SMTP failure rolls back complete auth state, then returns real user and confirms after recovery
L1-14/R02 reference EXISTING pending SMTP failure preserves identity/password/tokens and public resend genuinely recovers confirmation
L1-14/R03 reference pending signup retry preserves original password and real identity, respecting configured public resend429 without busy retries
L1-14/R04 reference public signup resend for UNKNOWN address is generic success with no auth rows or confirmation mail
L1-14/R05 reference public signup resend for CONFIRMED address is generic success with unchanged complete auth state and no new confirmation mail
L1-14/R06 reference aligned confirmation-enabled duplicate uses intentional placeholder, not a real new user or password/session overwrite

proof: Detected NEW signup SMTP500 returns null user/session and leaves complete users/identities/sessions/refresh/one-time-token/flow/audit row fingerprints unchanged; recovered signup returns actual stored real user, no session until real confirmation/password login.
EXISTING pending SMTP500 preserves exact identity/password/token/auth state; subsequent genuine public resend delivers confirmation and original-password login while replacement password fails.

Immediate public resend returns actual429 over_email_send_rate_limit under unchanged owned fixture1s setting; one configured cooldown wait then pending signup with replacement password preserves actual ID/original password; no busy retry/backdating/policy changes.

Unknown and confirmed signup resend use installed SDK with an observing real HTTP fetch (not a stub): actual200 empty-object body, null user/session, unchanged complete auth state and correlated no-new-mail postconditions.
Confirmed duplicate returns intentional placeholder/empty identities/null session, not a stored new user, with password/session/identity state unchanged and exactly one expected audit event.
unitGuard: Generated fixture SQL/mail literals only; malformed/SQL/foreign/whitespace inputs rejected before wire

tdd.runnerBeforeRegistration: Unknown Phase A suite, before any fixture/lock; independently owned checkout; raw/source evidence retained
tdd.note: Existing valid fixture literal guard already passed; no invented boundary bug or extra behavior fix.

limits: Alternate Supabase confirmation/autoconfirm configurations remain untested here.
Older confirmation-link invalidation, additional concurrent/cancellation/partial-acceptance SMTP and token/race controls remain required.
No native/SDK runtime implementation change or public resend support; official0358 null-user/pending409/SMTP/global-logout gaps remain visible.
No new three-browser auth application, physical-device, full security/fault/coverage/release or maintainer signoff inferred.
SMTP accepted and later lost/spam is not detected failure; transaction rollback cannot retract externally accepted mail.
